allowances.meaning: Pays $7.68 per shift (capped at $38.19 per week) to an employee who holds a current Senior First Aid Certificate and is requested or nominated by the employer to act as a first aider.
allowances.condition: Employee holds a current Senior First Aid Certificate and is requested or nominated by the employer to act as a first aider.

extraction.quote: The employer must pay the employee a first aid allowance of $7.68 per shift up to a maximum of $38.19 per week.

allowances.meaning: Pays $18.30 per rostered shift when an employee is required to work a rostered shift split into two separate periods of duty (excluding rest breaks).
allowances.condition: Employee is required to work a rostered shift in 2 periods of duty (excluding rest breaks).

extraction.quote: The employer of an employee who is required to work a rostered shift in 2 periods of duty (excluding rest breaks) must pay the employee a broken shift allowance of $18.30 per rostered shift.

allowances.meaning: Pays $47.68 per week to an employee required to supervise 1 to 5 other employees.
allowances.condition: Employee is required to supervise 1 to 5 other employees.

extraction.quote: (a) 1 to 5 employees—$47.68 per week; or

allowances.meaning: Pays $22.14 per occasion when an employee is required to work more than one hour beyond their ordinary shift without having been notified on or before the previous day.
allowances.condition: Employee is required to work more than one hour after the completion of their ordinary shift and was not advised of that requirement on or before the previous day.

extraction.quote: The employer must pay the employee a meal allowance of $22.14.

allowances.meaning: Pays $1.00 per kilometre when an employee is required to use their own motor vehicle in performing duties.
allowances.condition: Employer requires an employee to use their own motor vehicle in performing their duties.

extraction.quote: (i) motor vehicle—$1.00;
